status_rule: ACCEPTED when findings empty else REJECTED

encoding.determinism: byte-identical /app/build/active_learning_report.json across repeated make run on unchanged fixtures

policy_resolution: defaults then top-level suite fields then policy_overrides via ResolveSuite including max_score_age_rounds uncertainty_weight diversity_weight and max_channel_skew_rounds

label_accounting.seed_label: SEED_LABEL marks the sample labeled but must not increment labels_used and must not consume label_budget
label_accounting.pick_batch: each sample successfully labeled by an accepted PICK_BATCH increments labels_used by one and consumes budget
label_accounting.apply_label: first APPLY_LABEL on an unlabeled registered sample increments labels_used; repeated APPLY_LABEL is an idempotent no-op and never emits LABEL_LEAK

selection.hybrid_score: integer (uncertainty_weight times uncertainty plus diversity_weight times diversity plus 50) divided by 100
selection.hybrid_rank: descending hybrid_score then descending diversity then ascending sample_id
selection.candidate_pool: all registered unlabeled samples regardless of whether scores are present
selection.score_round: output score_round is the minimum of uncertainty_round and diversity_round when both exist, otherwise 0
selection.score_missing_order: before ranking inspect candidate_pool by ascending sample_id and emit SCORE_MISSING for the first sample missing either channel
selection.eligible: registered unlabeled sample with both uncertainty and diversity scored and both channel scores not stale
selection.stale_rule: after missing-score validation rank all complete candidates; for the best ranked candidate check uncertainty first then diversity and stale when current_round minus that channel round is strictly greater than max_score_age_rounds
selection.rescore_rule: each scoring event replaces only its own channel value and channel round; same-seq events replay by tie key then event_id so the later replayed event wins
selection.pick_count: min of batch_size remaining_budget and eligible count
selection.post_label_score: SCORE_UNCERTAINTY or SCORE_DIVERSITY on an already labeled registered sample emits POST_LABEL_SCORE at that event_seq entity_id sample_id detail exactly SCORE_UNCERTAINTY or SCORE_DIVERSITY; do not mutate channel values; do not increment score_calls
selection.channel_skew: on the best ranked complete candidate emit CHANNEL_SKEW when abs(uncertainty_round minus diversity_round) is strictly greater than max_channel_skew_rounds; detail is uncertainty_round colon diversity_round; checked after SCORE_MISSING and before STALE_SCORE

pick_batch_gate_order.budget_overrun: requested batch_size greater than remaining label_budget emits BUDGET_OVERRUN entity_id round_id detail remaining budget as decimal; remaining uses labels_used which excludes SEED_LABEL
pick_batch_gate_order.round_regression: a PICK_BATCH round strictly lower than the preceding PICK_BATCH round emits ROUND_REGRESSION entity_id round_id detail previous round decimal; every PICK_BATCH updates the preceding round even when another gate rejects it
pick_batch_gate_order.round_gap: after at least one prior PICK_BATCH, if current round is strictly greater than previous round plus one emit ROUND_GAP entity_id round_id detail expected next round as decimal equal to previous plus one; still update preceding round
pick_batch_gate_order.pool_exhausted: zero registered unlabeled samples emits POOL_EXHAUSTED; missing or stale scores do not make this pool empty
pick_batch_gate_order.score_missing: before ranking emit SCORE_MISSING for the lexicographically first registered unlabeled sample missing uncertainty or diversity
pick_batch_gate_order.stale_score: after all candidates have both scores rank them and inspect the best candidate; check uncertainty then diversity and emit STALE_SCORE detail channel colon channel_round
pick_batch_gate_order.label_leak: applies only to explicit picks in PICK_BATCH; APPLY_LABEL on an already labeled sample is an idempotent no-op
pick_batch_gate_order.batch_underfill: after filters selected count strictly less than requested batch_size and remaining budget allows full batch emits BATCH_UNDERFILL detail selected count
pick_batch_gate_order.duplicate_pick: same sample_id selected twice in one PICK_BATCH emits DUPLICATE_PICK
pick_batch_gate_order.channel_skew: abs channel round gap strictly greater than max_channel_skew_rounds emits CHANNEL_SKEW entity_id sample_id detail uncertainty_round colon diversity_round

metrics.annotation_efficiency_bps: when labels_used is 0 return 0; when final_accuracy_bps is strictly less than seed_accuracy_bps return 0; otherwise floor of (final_accuracy_bps minus seed_accuracy_bps) times 100 divided by labels_used. Example labels_used 2 final 8200 seed 5000 yields 160000
metrics.convergence_round: first RECORD_PROBE round_id where accuracy_bps is at least target_accuracy_bps else 0
metrics.confidence_lo_bps: when labels_used greater than 0 floor of final_accuracy_bps times labels_used divided by (labels_used plus confidence_z2) else 0. Example final 8200 labels_used 2 confidence_z2 4 yields 2733
metrics.compute_cost_milli: labels_used times cost_per_label_milli plus score_calls times cost_per_score_milli; score_calls counts orphan scores and successful channel updates on unlabeled registered samples but not POST_LABEL_SCORE events
metrics.cost_overflow: when compute_cost_milli strictly greater than max_compute_cost_milli emit COST_OVERFLOW at CLOSE_SUITE; equality does not emit
metrics.confidence_underflow: when labels_used strictly less than min_confidence_n at CLOSE_SUITE emit CONFIDENCE_UNDERFLOW
metrics.convergence_stall: when the last stall_rounds consecutive RECORD_PROBE accuracy deltas are each strictly less than stall_delta_bps emit CONVERGENCE_STALL at audit_seq entity_id equal to the last probe round_id string detail last delta
metrics.probe_regression: when a RECORD_PROBE accuracy_bps is strictly less than the previous RECORD_PROBE accuracy_bps emit PROBE_REGRESSION at that event_seq entity_id round_id detail previous accuracy decimal; still update final_accuracy_bps

post_audit.orphan_score: SCORE_UNCERTAINTY or SCORE_DIVERSITY for unregistered sample_id emits ORPHAN_SCORE once per sample_id at audit_seq which is max event seq plus one; finding event_seq equals audit_seq not the triggering score seq; entity_id sample_id detail exactly SCORE_UNCERTAINTY or SCORE_DIVERSITY

strategy_switch: second SET_STRATEGY with different strategy value emits STRATEGY_SWITCH entity_id new strategy detail prior strategy
hybrid_weight_invalid: uncertainty_weight plus diversity_weight must equal 100 and both non-negative otherwise HYBRID_WEIGHT_INVALID

finding_id.format: suite_id double colon entity_id double colon event_seq as four decimal digits
finding_id.event_seq_source: seq field of the triggering replay event not replay index

finding_entity_detail.DUPLICATE_SAMPLE: entity_id is sample_id; detail empty string
finding_entity_detail.UNKNOWN_STRATEGY: entity_id is strategy string; detail empty string
finding_entity_detail.HYBRID_WEIGHT_INVALID: entity_id is hybrid; detail is uncertainty_weight then colon then diversity_weight
finding_entity_detail.BUDGET_OVERRUN: entity_id is round_id; detail is remaining budget decimal
finding_entity_detail.LABEL_LEAK: entity_id is sample_id; detail empty string
finding_entity_detail.POOL_EXHAUSTED: entity_id is round_id; detail empty string
finding_entity_detail.STALE_SCORE: entity_id is sample_id; detail is uncertainty or diversity then colon then that channel round decimal
finding_entity_detail.ORPHAN_SCORE: entity_id is sample_id; detail is SCORE_UNCERTAINTY or SCORE_DIVERSITY
finding_entity_detail.BATCH_UNDERFILL: entity_id is round_id; detail is selected count decimal
finding_entity_detail.DUPLICATE_PICK: entity_id is sample_id; detail empty string
finding_entity_detail.CONVERGENCE_STALL: entity_id is last probe round_id; detail is last delta decimal
finding_entity_detail.COST_OVERFLOW: entity_id is suite_id; detail is compute_cost_milli decimal
finding_entity_detail.CONFIDENCE_UNDERFLOW: entity_id is suite_id; detail is labels_used decimal
finding_entity_detail.SCORE_MISSING: entity_id is sample_id; detail empty string
finding_entity_detail.STRATEGY_SWITCH: entity_id is new strategy; detail is prior strategy
finding_entity_detail.ROUND_REGRESSION: entity_id is round_id; detail is previous PICK_BATCH round decimal
finding_entity_detail.ROUND_GAP: entity_id is round_id; detail is expected next round decimal
finding_entity_detail.PROBE_REGRESSION: entity_id is round_id; detail is previous accuracy_bps decimal
finding_entity_detail.POST_LABEL_SCORE: entity_id is sample_id; detail is SCORE_UNCERTAINTY or SCORE_DIVERSITY
finding_entity_detail.CHANNEL_SKEW: entity_id is sample_id; detail is uncertainty_round then colon then diversity_round
